data_origin: Controlled six-compartment tracer transport identification study. Capacities, undirected conductance reference graphs and sensor observations are methodological benchmark inputs, not a claim about any empirical transport network.

capacities.interpretation: Known node storage capacities. State u is concentration; stored mass is diag(capacities)*u.

edge_weight_definition: Nonnegative undirected reference capacity factors in liters. Multiplying an edge weight by k (hour^-1) gives its conductance in liters/hour, so C^-1*L is dimensionless and T has units hour^-1. Graph labels describe reference normalizations; they are not distinguishable physical mechanisms by declaration.
physical_admissibility: Before using fit quality, require conservative transport in the declared concentration state: c^T*T=0 for every concentration vector, where c is the known capacity vector. L=diag(A row sums)-A for each candidate symmetric weighted adjacency A and C=diag(c). Off-diagonal transport coefficients must be nonnegative. Uniform first-order decay is separate: du/dt=(T-decay*I)*u. Candidate families that violate the stated mass balance are inadmissible even if a finite sensor subset could fit.
initial_condition: Total tracer mass at t=0 is exactly 1 mass unit, all at node A or F: m(0)=f*e_A+(1-f)*e_F, 0<=f<=1; u(0)=C^-1*m(0). f is unknown and continuous. Every experiment uses this same initial partition. There is no unknown detector baseline, source replenishment, or per-row calibration.
observation_model: All records are concentrations at their named node and time in hours. Preserve identities; source record order is deliberately shuffled. For a fixed graph/family/k/decay, predict u(t)=expm((T-decay*I)*t)*u(0), using the full matrix exponential. known_sigma is a strictly positive residual scale, not a fit parameter.
compatibility_policy: Retain EVERY physically admissible discrete graph/family/k/decay combination for which some f in [0,1] gives sum_over_all_observations[((predicted-observed)/known_sigma)^2] <= 9.0 inclusive. This fixed deterministic residual-tolerance policy is NOT a confidence-region claim. The entire continuous compatible f set must be retained for each discrete case; minimizing residuals alone does not establish point identification. Graph labels and k are separate reported parameters even if only their product is identifiable.
physical_quantities: For any retained case, effective bridge conductance in liters/hour is k times the reference edge weight specifically on the unordered edge C-D (zero when absent). Under conservative transport and uniform decay, total tracer mass at time t is sum_i c_i*u_i(t), in the same mass unit as the initial unit pulse. Report sharp envelopes over all retained cases and continuous compatible f values, not over one chosen fit.
reporting: Return admissible_generator_family_ids (the family passes mass balance for every provided graph), compatible_parameter_cases as unordered objects with graph_id,k_per_hour,decay_per_hour, initial_A_mass_fraction_interval (smallest and largest attainable f), reference_kinetic_scale_is_point_identified, effective_C_D_conductance_liters_per_hour_interval, and total_mass_at_4_hours_interval. Each interval is closed, lower then upper, and may be a degenerate interval. Absolute plus relative numeric tolerance 1e-7 each. Do not infer distinct microscopic networks or estimate future sensor concentrations from a single best-fit representative when the complete compatible set says otherwise.
